about.title: How to play
about.ripText: Each pack holds one country. A new pack arrives every {{cooldown}}, and you can hold up to {{max}}. When the stack is full the clock pauses, so open one to keep packs coming.
about.findText: Pick the continent first, then tap the country on the unlabelled map and confirm. Pinch or use the buttons to zoom; in crowded spots a magnifier helps you pick small countries.
about.findScope: This curated atlas has {{count}} collectible countries from a UN-based set (members plus the two observer states). Tuvalu, Vatican City, Monaco, Maldives and Nauru are deferred for map playability. Gray areas are outside this collection and cannot be selected; this is not a statement about their status.
about.continentRule: Each country has one accepted continent in this game. Russia, Turkey, Kazakhstan, Cyprus and the Caucasus count as Asia; Egypt counts as Africa. Central America and the Caribbean count as North America.
about.stampsText: Get both answers right first time to earn the silver Visitor stamp. Do it again to earn the gold Explorer stamp: two stamps unlock the country's card and take it out of future packs. A mistake shows you the answer but never removes stamps you already have.
about.rarityText: Your first pack reveals a country's name and fixed rarity. Five grades run from Common to Legendary, based mostly on Wikipedia language coverage and partly on size, not on a country's value. Switzerland is Legendary by a playful creator override. Higher grades are only slightly less likely in packs; all countries need the same two stamps: Visitor and Explorer.
about.sourceRarity: Rarity: frozen Wikidata Wikipedia-language coverage and REST Countries area data. Coverage is an imperfect familiarity proxy, not a recognition survey.
about.sourceBorders: Borders: Natural Earth 1:50m via world-atlas (public domain / ISC).
about.sourceNumbers: Population and area are rounded recent estimates.
about.sourceStorage: Progress and language are stored only in this browser.
